description: Hands the engine must REJECT: wrong tile counts, impossible tile multiplicities, no valid decomposition, malformed melds, bonus tiles in hand.

entries.title: Thirteen tiles - short hand
entries.cite: TT SS-Hand Structure: a standard winning hand is 4 sets plus 1 pair; each kong adds one tile. A hand that is not 14 + (kongs) tiles cannot win.

entries.title: Sixteen tiles declared with only one kong
entries.cite: TT SS-Hand Structure: a standard winning hand is 4 sets plus 1 pair; each kong adds one tile. A hand that is not 14 + (kongs) tiles cannot win.
entries.note: 14 concealed + 4 kong tiles = 18 for one kong; a one-kong hand must total 15.

entries.title: Five copies of one tile
entries.cite: TT SS-Tile system: 148 tiles, 4 copies of each suited and honour tile, and exactly one of each flower, season and animal.

entries.title: Five copies split across a meld and the hand
entries.cite: TT SS-Tile system: 148 tiles, 4 copies of each suited and honour tile, and exactly one of each flower, season and animal.
entries.note: Three 1m concealed plus a 1m kong is seven copies.
